item_051.one_line_why: Phenethyl-to-cyclopropyl is accurate and the N/O anchors remain, but no 3.65 A TYR43.CZ row exists: 3.65 A belongs to C21-MET635.CB or C3-GLU546.OE2.

item_052.one_line_why: Methyl-to-chlorine is the sole edit; C19-LEU168.O 3.18 A and the N03-LEU168.O amide bond are real, but methyl ownership is undecidable from this table (attribution accepted); ILE169 is absent.

item_053.one_line_why: Methoxy-to-chlorine is the sole edit and N24-THR179.O 2.76 A is retained; C19-LYS350.CG 3.41 A lies beside the O20 contact region, but its ownership by the methoxy versus retained aryl carbon is undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_054.one_line_why: The six-to-three-membered ring edit preserves stereochemistry, but the supplied table omits the claimed 3.40 A LYS54 and 2.60 A ASP167 rows; C37-TYR36.CB 3.48 A alone cannot establish the claimed ring ownership.

item_055.one_line_why: Both hydroxybutyl-to-phenyl and leucine-to-isoleucine edits are acknowledged, but ASN55 2.50 A belongs to retained sugar O4; the removed terminal oxygen is O19-HIS49.CB 3.66 A, while N-ASP80 2.87 A remains.

item_056.one_line_why: The N-methylacrylamide terminus becomes methoxy, retaining both chlorines; N1-PHE227.CB 3.46 A, O3-HIS235.O 3.94 A and CL1-LYS103.CE 3.38 A exist, but exact N/O ownership cannot be proved from the table (attribution accepted).

item_057.one_line_why: The starting ring is pyridazine, so two nitrogens become carbon; ARG794 2.74 A belongs to sulfonyl O5, supported by S1's same ARG794 neighborhood, rather than sugar; C25-PHE417.CE1 3.38 A is real.

item_058.one_line_why: The product has a methoxy-substituted carbocyclic aromatic ring, not a six-membered ring ether; O20-ARG28 2.90 A and C8-LYS12 1.34 A exist, but correspondence of the covalently linked atom through this core rewrite is undecidable (attribution accepted), so retained covalency is unsupported.

item_059.one_line_why: Cl-to-methyl is accompanied by unmentioned furan fusion/substituent connectivity changes and R-to-S stereochemistry; CL1-GLU108.O 2.42 A is explicitly uncertain, while the retained acid owns O3-ARG28 2.90 A.

item_060.one_line_why: Tetrahydropyran-to-cyclopropyl deletes the sole ether oxygen while retaining the lactam; O22-LYS54.NZ 3.23 A is real and its ether assignment is consistent with C21's LYS54 neighborhood; exact numbering remains undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_061.one_line_why: The removed aryl substituent is isopropyl, not isobutyl; C5-ILE1086.CG2 3.60 A and C22-CYS1115.SG 1.82 A are real, but their exact molecular ownership cannot be recovered conclusively from this table (attribution accepted).

item_062.one_line_why: The proposal removes the spiro system and rewires both sides of the piperidine amide into an achiral Boc-protected structure; no methyl-bearing stereocentre exists, and O22-ARG57 3.02 A carbonyl ownership is undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_063.one_line_why: Benzyl-to-pyridylmethyl is the only edit and both stereocentres remain; C5-HIS125.CD2 3.40 A and O4-GLN119 3.05 A exist, but aromatic-arm versus core ownership of C5 is genuinely undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_064.one_line_why: The hydroxypiperidinylmethyl replacement introduces two unspecified stereocentres; C11-LEU318.CD1 3.32 A ownership is undecidable (attribution accepted), MET265 N30/N34 hydrogen bonds exist, but GLN270 is absent.

item_065.one_line_why: Cyclohexylmethyl becomes phenethyl, adding an unmentioned linker carbon; C12-ARG392.CG 3.33 A and O4-GLN389 2.87 A are real, but the glycosidic-oxygen assignment is undecidable from the contact table (attribution accepted).

item_066.one_line_why: Thiosemicarbazone removal also adds an unmentioned aryl methyl; sulfur S3-PHE97 3.52 A, NH N4-MET98 2.89 A and retained phenolic O27-TYR158 2.49 A are supported, with no stereochemical change elsewhere.

item_067.one_line_why: Chlorofluorophenyl-to-pyridyl is the sole edit with retained stereochemistry; CL26-LEU148 3.85 A and F25-GLY210.O 3.50 A are explicit, and the retained carbonyl supports O23-ALA51.N 2.76 A without claiming a carbon hydrogen bond.

item_068.one_line_why: The chlorophenyl-to-pyridyl edit and CL-PRO287 3.52 A are real, as is C5-PHE319.O 3.61 A, but neither a 3.37 A contact nor HIS389 appears anywhere in the table.

item_069.one_line_why: The starting appendage is six-membered 1,4-dioxane, not dioxolane; the proposal is a stereodefined open triol, and C12-ARG392 3.47 A and retained N1-GLU390 2.78 A exist, although exact C12 ownership is undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_070.one_line_why: Acrylamide-to-methoxy is the sole edit; N2-TRP229.CB 3.48 A, O1-TYR318.OH 3.60 A and retained CL1-LYS103.CG 3.41 A are real, but amide-versus-nitrile N and carbonyl-versus-ether O ownership is undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_071.one_line_why: Acetylaminomethyl becomes piperidinylmethyl with the other basic arm preserved; CAM-GLY255.O 3.47 A and NBB-GLU236 2.77 A are real, but the alphabetic labels do not establish which arm owns them (attribution accepted).

item_072.one_line_why: Pyridazine-to-phenyl replaces two ring nitrogens, not a single pyridyl nitrogen; N4-PHE416.O 3.39 A is a genuine incompatible acceptor contact and the sugar donors remain; exact N4 numbering is undecidable (attribution accepted).

item_073.one_line_why: Methoxybenzyl-to-pyridylmethyl preserves the metal-binding enol ester and alkene geometry; O26-HIS75 2.89 A and O2-MN202 2.40 A are real, but C27-HIS75 3.13 A may be methoxy methyl rather than ring carbon, an undecidable assignment (attribution accepted).

item_074.one_line_why: The full thiosemicarbazone becomes carboxamide, not merely thiourea; N4/N5-GLN214 belong to the retained triazole contact region rather than the MET98/PHE97 thiosemicarbazone end, and LYS227 is absent; phenol O-TYR158 2.47 A remains.

item_075.one_line_why: CF3-to-OH is the sole edit with retained R stereochemistry; removed F1-PRO110.O 3.50 A and F2-GLU108.O 3.14 A and retained acid O3-ARG28 2.63 A are explicit table rows; the proposed polar replacement is a reasonable hypothesis.
